next_question.rationale: Item_count already shows a large conversion gap (1_item rate 0.4422 vs 3_to_5_items rate 0.2494), and multi-item baskets are more likely to fail confirmation when one or more SKUs are unavailable. A stock_status cut will show whether an 'out_of_stock' or 'partial_out_of_stock' segment has a much lower created→confirmed conversion and thus explains a meaningful share of the 417,569 lost orders; that identifies whether inventory/availability fixes are high leverage. Also_dimension is null because this is the last untried rate-bearing dimension.
